policy: Loop 017 uses the complete photo set supplied by the association owner. No additional permission gate is imposed by this project workflow.

permissions.social_media_photos: OWNER-SUPPLIED AND VERBALLY AUTHORISED: the association owner supplied the photo set (including all assets/posts photographs and gathering.jpeg) and authorised their visible use on this website, as relayed by the project user on 2026-11-05.
permissions.identifiable_people: The supplied group, activity and children/young-people photographs are included in the website under the association owner's verbal authorization, as relayed by the project user. Captions describe activities and scenes without naming individuals.
permissions.user_supplied_facebook_page: Exact Facebook URL remains linked. User supplied the official transparent logo and original page images in the repository.
permissions.owner_authorization: CONFIRMED AT PROJECT LEVEL: according to the project user, the association owner supplied all photo assets and verbally authorised visible use on the website. Accepted as sufficient permission for this project; no additional authorization request is pending.
permissions.participant_image_releases: No additional release document is required by the project workflow: the user confirms the association owner supplied the images and verbally authorised their visible use. Captions avoid names and identity claims.
permissions.logo_palette: SAMPLED IN LOOP 011 from the uploaded transparent RGBA logo; Loop 012 SVG illustrations use the sampled blue family.

optimization: The homepage sticky collage uses five local JPEG drawings loaded eagerly. Eleven locally supplied assets/posts photos are displayed in a responsive album using lazy loading and descriptive alt text. The locally supplied gathering.jpeg is placed beside the closing contact content. No remote image host, remote font, tracking or paid dependency is introduced.
